name: Prochytay moyi dumky
source:
A small game created as part of the Ukrainian Gamejam.

The story about a young couple - Mark and Yana, as well as about a detective, a psychologist...

[Translated from [url=https://vovametzker.itch.io/readmyth]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为乌克兰Gamejam的一部分创建的小游戏。

故事讲述了一对年轻夫妇——马克和亚娜，以及一名侦探、一名心理学家的故事……
